clock.scope: one device/rank; AIC, AIV0, and AIV1 use the same device system-cycle domain; ranks are decoded separately
clock.zero_handling: a sampled low-32 system-cycle value of zero is remapped to one so zero remains an unambiguous missing sentinel

comparison_group.label: AI Block
comparison_group.reason: AIC, AIV0, and AIV1 with the same paired core index form one physical AI Block and share a synchronized timestamp; different AI Blocks may have fixed timestamp offsets

visualization.protocol_impact: none; row grouping, reference selection, labels, and Chinese descriptions do not change device fields or wire bytes

protocol.record_order_description: AIC[0..aicNum-1], AIV0[0..aicNum-1], then AIV1[0..aicNum-1], each in ascending physical paired-core index
protocol.header_contract: 30 little-endian uint32 words; magic is published last after every record writer rendezvous; runtime fields identify only the current MTE A8W8 MegaMoeWave path and carry shape, role counts, capture/truncation, flags, config hash, and y capacity
protocol.flags_contract: required 0x000000ff: bit0 diagnostic y reuse; bit1 terminal mixed AIC/AIV rendezvous; bit2 record-before-header rendezvous; bit3 magic-last publication; bit4 Dispatch MTE3_S end bridge; bit5 GMM FIX_S bridges; bit6 SwiGLU V_S begin bridge; bit7 Combine MTE2_S end bridge

output.carrier: diagnostic reuse of y as raw bytes after all BF16 Unpermute output stores complete; required bytes=(30 + 3*aicNum*18)*4
output.capacity_check: device computes uint64 carrierBytes=bs*h*sizeof(OutputType) and writes no header or record unless carrierBytes >= (30 + 3*aicNum*18)*4; runtime header also reports carrier_words and parser verifies it against raw length
output.write_phase: after role-local work_end_S, Unpermute final MTE3_V completion, mixed AIC/AIV rendezvous, and useful y lifetime; records first, second mixed rendezvous, header fields next, magic last
output.rendezvous: AscendC::SyncAll<false>() includes both AIC and AIV: first protects y from late Unpermute writers, second waits for every role record before AIC0 publishes the header

points.scope: once at MegaMoeWave::Process entry per physical role/core record
points.why: Provides one local shared-axis reference for AIC, AIV0, and AIV1 inside the same physical AI Block, without asserting clock alignment across AI Blocks or ranks; also exposes role launch skew before input preparation.
points.semantics: Scalar has entered the current MTE A8W8 MegaMoeWave Process body and no operator work has yet been issued by this role/core.

dependency.precondition: mixed-kernel task entry for this physical role/core
dependency.proof: The clock is the first diagnostic instruction immediately before the first Process statement.

points.perturbation: One 32-bit GetSystemCycle and one named Scalar assignment per role/core.

points.scope: once after useful work and overflow-mode restoration per physical role/core record
points.why: Separates the real role-local useful-work tail from the diagnostic rendezvous and y record emission overhead.
points.semantics: All useful work owned by this role is complete; for AIV roles Unpermute has consumed its final MTE3_V completion event, and routed AIC publications already passed FIX_S.

dependency.precondition: role-local GMM/Combine completion and, on AIV, final Unpermute y store completion
dependency.producer_pipeline: FIX and Scalar for AIC; MTE3, Vector, and Scalar for AIV
dependency.bridge: existing PublishGmm2Ready FIX_S and Unpermute final MTE3_V waits; no additional hot-path bridge
dependency.proof: The sample is after ProcessRoutedExpertWaves, cross-rank completion, Unpermute's final MTE3_V wait, and control-state restoration, but before either trace rendezvous.

points.perturbation: One 32-bit GetSystemCycle and assignment before trace-only terminal synchronization.

points.scope: first dispatched expert per physical AIV1 core per captured routed-expert wave
points.why: Measures the actual per-wave AIV1 prefetch window, including send-count calculation, rather than the outer wave that may prefetch two waves at once.
points.semantics: The first expert in this dispatch wave is about to start SendCntCal on the AIV1 Scalar/control path.

dependency.precondition: the monotonic dispatch cursor selected this expert and any prior Combine ring reuse was drained by the preceding wave
dependency.proof: DispatchExpert is invoked exactly once per expert by DispatchExpertsUntil; the first-expert test maps expertIdx to the current host-derived experts_per_wave.

points.perturbation: One first-wave-slot check plus one clock sample per active AIV1/wave.

points.scope: last dispatched expert per physical AIV1 core per captured routed-expert wave
points.why: Proves when each AIV1 has completed the token/scale/meta-info writes that release GMM1 and permits direct comparison with GMM1 readiness.
points.semantics: The last expert handled by this AIV1 in the wave has completed all Dispatch MTE3 writes and ready publications.

dependency.precondition: CopyGMToGMPerToken has recycled every dynamic ring slot and MetaInfoCalAndDispatch has issued its final publication
dependency.bridge: trace-only MTE3_S using recycled EVENT_ID0 on the last expert of the wave
dependency.proof: All EVENT_ID0..5 Dispatch ring lifetimes are paired before MetaInfoCalAndDispatch returns; the added MTE3_S orders the last output/publication into Scalar before sampling.

points.perturbation: One MTE3-to-Scalar bridge and one clock sample per active AIV1/wave.

points.scope: first actually assigned GMM1 tile per physical AIC core per captured routed-expert wave
points.why: Distinguishes Dispatch-ready and prior ping-pong dependency time from actual first GMM1 MMAD issue on each AIC.
points.semantics: Dispatch GM readiness polling and any outstanding AIC-to-AIV0 acknowledgement have passed and the first GMM1 tile is about to construct and issue MMAD work.

dependency.precondition: WaitForUpstreamReady observed the complete Dispatch wave count and any WaitForVector dependency for this owner completed
dependency.bridge: trace-only FIX_S using recycled EVENT_ID0 before the first sampled tile
dependency.proof: The hook is after both upstream readiness and ping-pong waits in AicComputeGeneric; FIX_S transfers the FIX wait/completion dependency to Scalar before the clock.

points.perturbation: One conditional slot check, one FIX-to-Scalar bridge, and one clock per active AIC/wave.

points.scope: after the last GMM1 tile assigned to each physical AIC core in a captured routed-expert wave
points.why: Makes the GMM1 interval end at actual local FIX completion instead of helper return or AIV notification issue.
points.semantics: All GMM1 FIX work assigned to this AIC in the wave is complete.

dependency.precondition: ProcessGmm1Wave returned after issuing every owned GMM1 tile
dependency.bridge: trace-only FIX_S using recycled EVENT_ID0 when this core recorded GMM1 work
dependency.proof: The bridge is after the complete wave loop and executes only for records with a causal begin, so its Scalar clock cannot run ahead of the final FIX operation.

points.perturbation: One FIX-to-Scalar completion bridge and clock per active AIC/wave.

points.scope: first non-empty epilogue tile per physical AIV0 core per captured routed-expert wave
points.why: Places the common SwiGLU begin after both non-prefetch WaitForCube and prefetch MTE2_V input readiness, regardless of the current epilogue branch.
points.semantics: A non-empty epilogue invocation has all upstream GMM1/input dependencies ordered into Vector and is about to start SwiGLU/quant setup and Vector work.

dependency.precondition: the caller passed its AIC-to-AIV0 V wait or MTE2_V data-ready wait before entering the epilogue
dependency.bridge: trace-only V_S using recycled EVENT_ID0 at the common epilogue entry
dependency.proof: Every routed wave epilogue branch calls this operator only after its readiness wait; V_S orders those V-pipeline waits before the first recorded clock.

points.perturbation: One conditional slot check, one Vector-to-Scalar bridge, and one clock per active AIV0/wave.

points.scope: after the last epilogue tile assigned to each physical AIV0 core in a captured routed-expert wave
points.why: Shows the actual AIV0 epilogue completion and its overlap with AIC GMM2 and AIV1 Dispatch/Combine.
points.semantics: Every SwiGLU/quant GM output owned by this AIV0 in the wave has completed.

dependency.precondition: all BlockEpilogueSwigluMxQuant invocations assigned to the core returned
dependency.bridge: existing per-tile MTE3_S in BlockEpilogueSwigluMxQuant::operator(); no added end bridge
dependency.proof: Each operator return consumes MTE3_V and MTE3_S after data/scale copies and then publishes its ready count; the outer wave return therefore follows the last actual GM completion.

points.perturbation: One clock and named assignment per active AIV0/wave; no additional completion serialization.

points.scope: first actually assigned GMM2 tile per physical AIC core per captured routed-expert wave
points.why: Measures GMM2 only after the current wave's SwiGLU-ready counter is visible, leaving publication-to-observation latency outside GMM2 compute.
points.semantics: Scalar GM polling has observed the required SwiGLU-ready count for the first owned GMM2 wave tile and MMAD issue is next.

dependency.precondition: WaitForUpstreamReady observed the wave-grained swigluToGmm2Flag target
dependency.producer_pipeline: MTE3 completion published through Scalar-visible GM AtomicAdd
dependency.proof: The bypass GM polling loop runs on Scalar and returns only after epilogue MTE3_S and ready AtomicAdd; the immediately following Scalar clock is causally ordered without a cross-pipeline bridge.

points.perturbation: One conditional slot check and one clock per active AIC/wave.

points.scope: after the last ready publication for GMM2 work assigned to each physical AIC core in a captured routed-expert wave
points.why: Proves local GMM2 direct-GM completion and ready publication timing while keeping remote AIV1 observation as a separate handoff gap.
points.semantics: All owned GMM2 FIX writes for the wave are complete and the final per-expert ready publication has been issued by this AIC.

dependency.precondition: ProcessGmm2Wave completed every expert and PublishGmm2Ready ran after each expert
dependency.producer_pipeline: FIX then Scalar bypass GM store
dependency.bridge: existing FIX_S inside PublishGmm2Ready; no extra bridge
dependency.proof: PublishGmm2Ready executes FIX_S before WriteGmByPassDCache; the outer sample follows the last publication in source and Scalar order. It does not claim AIV1 has observed it.

points.perturbation: One clock and named assignment per active AIC/wave; existing production FIX_S publication semantics are reused.

points.scope: first non-empty token range per physical AIV1 core per captured routed-expert wave
points.why: Exposes the publication-to-ready-observation handoff and starts Combine only after the full AIC fan-in is proven.
points.semantics: This AIV1 owns at least one token and its first expert's GMM2-ready scan has observed all AIC publications; meta-info load and first row send follow.

dependency.precondition: WaitGmm2Ready reduced all per-AIC ready cache lines to at least blockNum
dependency.bridge: existing MTE2_V and V_S in WaitGmm2Ready
dependency.proof: WaitGmm2Ready returns only after the V_S-ordered sum is read on Scalar and meets the all-AIC target; the marker is immediately after that return.

points.perturbation: One conditional slot check and one clock per active AIV1/wave.

points.scope: after the final remote-send ring drain per physical AIV1 core per captured routed-expert wave
points.why: Ends Combine at actual remote MTE3 send completion rather than at Scalar issue or ring-drain enqueue time.
points.semantics: Every token row issued by this AIV1 for the wave has completed its remote MTE3 send.

dependency.precondition: DrainCombineRowRing consumed every MTE3_MTE2 event for each actually used row slot
dependency.producer_pipeline: MTE3 completion dependency held by MTE2
dependency.bridge: trace-only MTE2_S using recycled EVENT_ID0 after the drain
dependency.proof: The ring drain waits only the slots that were issued; MTE2_S transfers those completed MTE3 dependencies to Scalar before sampling.

points.perturbation: One MTE2-to-Scalar bridge and one clock per active AIV1/wave.
